title: Purple Space Cats from Outer Space
description: Princess Whiskers’ kind are in an epic 3-dimensional war with the humans. She wants to be friends with one, and must convince her father, King Tummyrub Tum Tum, that humans aren’t so bad.
quote: Why can’t humans and purple space cats just live in peace?
altHero: Princess Whiskers, a purple space cat, and her friend who is a human disguised as one
alt2: human friend sticking out his drooly tongue
alt3: King Tummyrub Tum Tum and warrior purple space cats
alt4: King Tummyrub Tum Tum holds up a shining ball of yarn
